claim: A LAPL(A) pilot may carry up to three passengers regardless of how many PIC hours they have flown since the licence was issued.

evidence.summary: A LAPL(A) holder may carry a maximum of three passengers only after completing 10 hours as PIC after licence issuance.
FCL.105.A permits passenger carriage only if 10 post-licence PIC hours have been completed.
Passenger privileges are subject to an initial post-licence PIC requirement.
A newly licensed holder cannot carry passengers until the required PIC experience is complete.
The three-passenger ceiling applies only after the initial experience condition is met.

claim: The pyramids were constructed to harness energy.

evidence.summary: The article discusses alternative theories suggesting that the pyramids could have functioned as power-generating facilities.
The source describes the concept of pyramid power and says that proponents claimed pyramids could harness energy.
The source speculates that the Great Pyramid was a power-generating station.
Archaeological evidence identifies the pyramids and their surrounding complexes as royal funerary monuments.
Historical records and archaeological evidence identify the standardized pyramid complex as the king's tomb and funerary cult site.
